$about: Per-key placeholder registry GENERATED from commerce-source-en.json (same placeholder name may have different semantics under different keys — the key-scoped meaning here is authoritative). Translators must keep placeholder names EXACTLY as-is. Regenerate/verify via scripts/i18n/check-commerce-i18n.mjs --write-registry.

cart.items.count: number of line items in the cart (drives the plural branch)

cart.removeItemAria.product: product name of the cart line from Saleor

cart.variantAttribute.name: attribute name from Saleor backend data (e.g. "Size")
cart.variantAttribute.value: attribute value name from Saleor backend data (e.g. "XL")

cart.variantLabel.variant: variant name from Saleor backend data

checkout.addressForm.fieldInvalid.field: The localized address-field label, e.g. 'Mesto' (already translated via the address field label keys)

checkout.addressForm.fieldRequired.field: The localized address-field label, e.g. 'Mesto' / 'PSČ' (already translated via the address field label keys)

checkout.addressForm.notAvailableInCount.country: The localized name of the delivery country, e.g. 'Deutschland'

checkout.addressForm.phoneExamplePair.national: The example as written at home, e.g. '01512 3456789' (from src/checkout/lib/consts/phone-examples.ts; not translated)
checkout.addressForm.phoneExamplePair.international: The same number with the country's calling code, e.g. '+49 1512 3456789' (not translated)

checkout.addressForm.phoneHint.example: The delivery country's example in both forms, joined by `phoneExamplePair`, e.g. '01512 3456789 or +49 1512 3456789' (not translated)

checkout.addressForm.phoneInvalid.example: The example number of the country the number belongs to: both forms joined by `phoneExamplePair` ('01512 3456789 or +49 1512 3456789'), or the international form alone when the customer wrote a calling code (not translated)
checkout.addressForm.phoneInvalid.country: The localized name of the country the example belongs to, e.g. 'Deutschland'

checkout.addressForm.phoneOtherCountry.country: The localized name of the delivery country, e.g. 'Deutschland'
checkout.addressForm.phoneOtherCountry.otherCountry: The localized name of the country the number looks like it belongs to, e.g. 'Slowakei'
checkout.addressForm.phoneOtherCountry.suggestion: The customer's own number with that country's calling code, e.g. '+421 901 234 561' (not translated)

checkout.addressForm.phoneTooLong.example: The example number of the country the number belongs to: both forms joined by `phoneExamplePair` ('01512 3456789 or +49 1512 3456789'), or the international form alone when the customer wrote a calling code (not translated)
checkout.addressForm.phoneTooLong.country: The localized name of the country the example belongs to, e.g. 'Deutschland'

checkout.addressForm.phoneTooShort.example: The example number of the country the number belongs to: both forms joined by `phoneExamplePair` ('01512 3456789 or +49 1512 3456789'), or the international form alone when the customer wrote a calling code (not translated)
checkout.addressForm.phoneTooShort.country: The localized name of the country the example belongs to, e.g. 'Deutschland'

checkout.addressForm.phoneUseSuggestion.suggestion: The customer's own number with a calling code, e.g. '+421 901 234 561' (not translated)

checkout.addressForm.postalCodeInvalid.country: The localized name of the address country, e.g. 'Deutschland'
checkout.addressForm.postalCodeInvalid.example: The country's example postal code from Saleor's address rules, e.g. '10115' (not translated)

checkout.confirmation.codNotice.total: The order total, formatted with currency, e.g. '106,99 €'

checkout.confirmation.emailNoticeWithAdd.confirmationEmail: customer e-mail address the order confirmation will be sent to (order.userEmail; never empty — the Generic variant renders otherwise)

checkout.confirmation.orderNumberLine.orderNumber: Saleor order number (e.g. 1023); in the dormant demo confirmation step a DEMO-XXXXXX code

checkout.contactSection.resetLinkSent.email: the email address the customer typed into the sign-in form

checkout.payment.codBody.total: The order total with the cash-on-delivery fee, formatted with currency, e.g. '106,99 €'
checkout.payment.codBody.fee: The cash-on-delivery fee, formatted with currency, e.g. '3,00 €'

checkout.payment.codOverMax.max: The highest order total for cash on delivery, formatted with currency, e.g. '500,00 €'

checkout.payment.freeOrderBody.total: Formatted order total with currency, e.g. 0,00 €

checkout.payment.loadingGateway.gateway: Payment gateway display name, e.g. Stripe

checkout.payment.priceChangedBody.previousTotal: Formatted previous order total including currency symbol (getFormattedMoney)
checkout.payment.priceChangedBody.newTotal: Formatted new order total including currency symbol (getFormattedMoney)

checkout.promo.giftCard.code: last characters of the gift card code, as Saleor shows them (e.g. AB12)

checkout.promo.giftCardBalance.amount: the card's current balance, already formatted as money in the market's locale

checkout.promo.remove.code: the discount code as applied, or the last characters of the gift card

checkout.shipping.deliveryEstimate.max: method.maximumDeliveryDays (number); also drives the plural branch

checkout.shipping.noMethodsForCountry.countryName: Localized country name of the shipping address (Intl.DisplayNames via localizeCountryName, threaded with the market locale), always rendered inside parentheses — grammatically inert, no inflection needed. When unresolvable the code renders checkout.shipping.noMethodsForCountryGeneric instead.

checkout.steps.progress.stepCount: total number of visible checkout steps (2 or 3)

checkout.summary.discountAppliedCode.code: the discount code the customer applied, as Saleor stores it

checkout.summary.discountCode.code: The discount code the customer entered, e.g. 'SAVE10' (not translated)

email.accountChangeEmailConfirm.intro.firstName: customer first name from the Notify payload (user.first_name); the *Generic variant renders when it is missing
